name: Renaissance Asia Silk Road Group Limited
summary: Renaissance Asia Silk Road Group Limited operates as an investment holding company, with its primary focus on the discovery, extraction, and processing of gold deposits throughout mainland China and Hong Kong. The firm's diverse business is structured into three principal divisions: Mining Products, Money Lending, and Trading and Wholesale. Beyond its core mining interests, the company also extends its services to financial lending, participates in the trading of coal, and is involved in the wholesale and distribution of frozen meat. Incorporated in 2000, the organization's corporate headquarters are situated in Central, Hong Kong. It previously conducted business under the name China Billion Resources Limited, before officially changing to Renaissance Asia Silk Road Group Limited in November 2021.
